p2: The visual novel 『Summer Jasmine』 is a yuri-themed role-playing game.

Players will experience the story through Yutong Zhu's perspective, spending a conflicted and innocent summer filled with uncertainty. Through a series of choices and clicks, the story will ultimately lead to different endings.
This is a story about “wishes.” We have all imagined that, one day, we could return to the past and change ourselves.
As if healing the scars of the past could prevent the nightmares of the future from ever happening.

It is also a story about “forgetting”—children preparing to leave their hometown, a train ticket bound for somewhere far away, and a city that gradually becomes unfamiliar. As the old scenery fades away, memories become yellowed old photographs.
Summer, a small town, jasmine. Leaving and staying, and a truth kept hidden. Beneath the dull repetition of everyday life, how will the protagonists face their own fates?

Dream a little. Together, return to that gentle summer afternoon: yawning at our desks in the classroom, laughing and playing beneath the shade of the trees along the avenue, savoring delicious mousse cake, and cautiously trying dishes we've never tasted before.
Where will the story lead? The final ending is determined by your choices.
p3: After the end of her second year of high school, Yutong Zhu, one of the top students in her regular class, unexpectedly receives a notice about attending a special-term remedial program. Students who perform exceptionally well during the program will have the opportunity to remain in the advanced class.
For her, with her final year of high school just around the corner, being in the advanced class means better teaching resources and a better classroom environment.
The person who brings her this “good news” is Qiaoyi Qiu, the girl she has always admired.
Qiaoyi Qiu unexpectedly enters Yutong Zhu's life, and one unexpected event follows another. The introverted Yutong Zhu ends up living together with Qiaoyi Qiu.
What kind of story will unfold during their life together?
As layer upon layer of fog lifts, there is no turning back on the road to the truth.
